body.x: Linx(https://www.linx.net), at the center of the UK Internet and one the world's largest Internet Exchange Points (IXP), unveils Linx Impact Assessment System (IAS) at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Linx Impact Assessment System (IAS) is a real-time sports impact monitoring system that empowers parents, coaches and athletes with the ability to manage potential head injuries. The system comprises a small device about the weight of a nickel that is worn in a specially designed headband or skull cap. The device measures and records all impacts to the head, sending immediate feedback to a mobile device through the Linx IAS app.Developed by BlackBox Biometrics, the industry leader in sensor technology to measure concussive forces, Linx IAS is the complete system to monitor sports head impacts. With a pedigree of developing blast-force sensors used in military and law enforcement settings, BlackBox Biometrics brings its proven expertise in measuring the unseen impact of concussive forces from the battlefield to the playing field with Linx IAS.
